en: A black‑and‑white postcard depicting an ornate Baroque pavilion with elaborate sculptures, large arched windows, and a grand stairway leading up to the entrance. In the foreground on the right stands a large sculpted figure, while a person in a coat walks along the terrace. The architecture is part of a larger courtyard complex surrounded by arcades and balustrades. The caption at the bottom right reads "Dresden. Zwinger-Wallpavillon".
